svg.title: Tidewharf · Pearl Citadel · Sunken Shrine

a.title: A customs hut, two ferries and their mast gantries create a welcoming dock maze. Cargo stacks connect the boardwalk to the sail loft; danger berths are clearly separated.
Five craft stalls arc around a loading court. Shell roofs, fish crates and kelp-rope catwalks connect the smith, armorer, provisions and arcane galleries.
An open basin sits below a permanent ring boardwalk. Three tide stairs reach lower sample platforms; the gauge tower and ferry shed make the upper loop.
Kelp racks rise through three sheltered terraces to a mixing room. Mortar tables, crate steps and drying beams offer low hops beside proper stairs.
Six dry training stations surround a shallow drill basin. Tethered pontoons, rope ladders and a high gong deck offer a playful route without a swimming prerequisite.
A shell-vaulted common room opens onto a sunset deck. Bunk lofts, luggage shelves and a serving hatch make an upper loop around the central hearth.
A wide dry crown crosses the tidal gates. Counterweight rooms, maintenance stairs and kelp rigging frame Nacre’s turning space without obstructing refusal or retreat.
Two shell arches frame a quiet return door. A guard balcony and sluice inspection gantry branch toward the barracks and cistern; the ceremonial road continues to Pearl Hall.
Bunk pods and gear galleries wrap a dry practice court. A low wet demonstration lane has a parallel dry deck; footlockers lead to observation platforms.
Parallel freshwater channels sit below a continuous maintenance gallery. Three symbol valves, tool benches and counterweight baskets form the inspection loop.
A fan of shell ribs leads to Amaya’s dais. Side galleries separate Tide Chamber, Deepvault and shrine descent; benches and a record table add small playable surfaces.
A huge tidal window and listening dais dominate the chamber. Pearl instrument shelves and a rear maintenance stair create a contemplative loop around the Speaker.
Raised archive shelves straddle an observation channel. Rolling ladders and table tops reach the rubbing desk, then a kelp rope drops to the return aisle.
The causeway descends beside the sea wall. Permanent handrail stairs follow upper alcoves; tide stones and a suspended repair cradle form the optional lower route.
A cathedral gallery descends above three symbol-marked sluices. Broken pews and inspection decks create close exploration; a fixed rope returns to the high entrance.
Three carved conduit stations step toward the unique pearl lens. Reading shelves and stone benches support short hops; the archive rubbing order remains visible from the central landing.
A pearl altar bridges two quiet pools. Service stairs and a rear conduit gallery reach the regulator; the lens approach is ceremonial, with a clear return to the Reliquary.

svg.text: Click a place to open its complete side-scroll SVG. Every drawn road is a reciprocal portal connection.
Outer village: shared · Stronghold / story: Light allegiance · Story doors also retain their authored quest or tide checks.
